name: Nagram
tagline: A Telegram fork with translation and proxy tools
description:
Nagram is an unofficial Telegram app based on NekoX. It uses your normal Telegram account and keeps the familiar layout, then piles on extras: translate messages, selected text and articles, undo and redo while typing, combine messages, forced copy, unlimited logged-in accounts, a scrollable chat preview, and noise suppression for voice messages.

Where it really goes further is proxies. It has built-in support for VMess, Shadowsocks, SSR and Trojan proxies, proxy subscriptions in many formats, import by QR code, speed testing, sorting and automatic switching — handy in places where Telegram is blocked.

Two things to know: it is an unofficial client, so Telegram's servers and rules still apply, and the project notes that the bundled proxy support is no longer actively maintained.
